_about: Park composting and on-site (home) composting. Land norms are sourced; everything marked sourced: false is a planning assumption, editable. The per-site cap is read from the SWM Rules 2026 buffer-zone threshold in the regulations library, not from this file.

cpheeo_t35.title: CPHEEO Municipal Solid Waste Management Manual, Part II, Table 3.5 'Summary of different composting technologies' (developed by ICLEI South Asia). Copy consulted: May 2014 edition.

vermi.label: Vermicomposting
vermi.note: Land requirement 2 ha for 50 TPD, i.e. 20,000 m2 per 50,000 kg/day. Maturation about 8 weeks, no odour issues, temperature sensitive (30-40 C).

windrow.label: Windrow composting
windrow.note: Land requirement 8 ha for 500 TPD, i.e. 80,000 m2 per 500,000 kg/day. Maturation about 8 weeks; odour if turning is inadequate. Norm is for large plants; small park sites will reach less.

share._note: Share of each park's area set aside for composting. Smaller parks set aside a larger share so the site stays workable; larger parks a smaller share. Unsourced planning assumption agreed with the project lead.

min_site_m2.note: Smaller sites are not shown as usable.

catchment_radius_m.note: Road distance from a building to the park site: walkable for residents, a short detour for vehicles.

resident_dropoff_pct.note: Share of the wet waste allocated to a park that residents carry there themselves; collection vehicles bring the rest.

compost_yield_pct.note: Finished compost as a share of wet waste input by weight (commonly quoted 20-30%).

park_unload_min.note: Time for a collection vehicle to unload wet waste at a park site.

home_compost_share._note: Share of a building's wet waste composted on site, from the surveyor's answer, when no kg/day figure is recorded. Unsourced planning assumption.
